in_sanskrit.name: Antika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ancient, Timeless
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Antika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Antika refers to the ancient or timeless in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'antikah', which means 'ancient' or 'timeless'. This name is often given to girls born into families with a rich cultural heritage, as it is believed to symbolize the enduring nature of their lineage and traditions.
